headline: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
summary: Sony is not abandoning its plan to cease disc production by January 2028. However, the company is slowing down the shutdown of its disc-making operations. Reports of a plant being 90% repurposed were inaccurate; the process is less rapid.

headline: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
summary: OpenAI claims to have solved the Navier-Stokes problem, unsolved for 90 years. This major mathematical breakthrough relates to the flow of liquids. The announcement, initially reported by major outlets, is now surrounded by "drama."

headline: Rivian spinout Also apologizes for delays in shipping futuristic e-bikes
summary: Rivian's micromobility spinoff, Also, has delayed its futuristic TM-B e-bike. Customers are expressing dissatisfaction over the shipping delays. The TM-B features a unique software-controlled pedal-by-wire system and USB-C charging.

headline: Razer’s ANC-equipped gaming headset for PS5 and Xbox is almost $100 off
summary: The Razer BlackShark V3 Pro gaming headset is on sale for $164.99, nearly $100 off. It features active noise cancellation (ANC), a rare high-end feature at this price. The Xbox version is recommended as it's compatible with PlayStation, PC, and Switch.

headline: AMC Theaters Is Broadcasting the 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals at Select Cinemas Across the US
summary: The 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals will be shown in cinemas. 50 AMC Theaters across the US will broadcast the esports event. This marks a unique partnership for competitive gaming viewership.

headline: SteelSeries Aeon Pro Review So Far
summary: The SteelSeries Aeon Pro controller offers numerous pro-level features. It includes Hall-effect thumbsticks, tactile buttons, and adjustable triggers. A standout feature is its hot-swappable battery system for convenience.

headline: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Is Finally Getting a 4K Blu-ray Release Ahead of Season 3
summary: "The Rings of Power" Season 1 and 2 are getting a 4K Blu-ray release. This physical release comes ahead of the show's anticipated third season. Fans can now own the Prime Video series in high-definition physical format.

headline: The Bomb Busters Board Game Drops to Its Lowest Price Ever at Amazon
summary: The "Bomb Busters" board game is currently available at its lowest price. This deal is being offered on Amazon. Gamers can grab the game at a significant discount.

headline: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
summary: The UK announced sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlements. Britain's foreign secretary accused settlers of "ethnic cleansing" Palestinians. Israel responded by closing the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

headline: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
summary: British-Israeli relations are at their lowest point in decades. This follows the UK's trade ban on Israeli settlements in the West Bank. The severity of Israel's response highlights the critical nature of the moment.

headline: More flight delays expected after hundreds cancelled by air traffic control glitch
summary: Further flight delays are anticipated after hundreds of cancellations. A technical glitch affecting air traffic control provider Nats caused the disruption. Departures from multiple airports are impacted by the ongoing problem.

headline: US strikes Iranian oil tankers as Tehran targets American base in Jordan
summary: The US struck Iranian oil tankers in retaliation. Tehran had previously targeted an American base in Jordan. Oil prices surged towards $100 a barrel amidst the escalating conflict.
